correctness.rationale: The estimator is unbiased by direct integration. The density normalization follows from arsinh(sinh 1)=1. Step-function risk is identically V*: the squared-moment correction equals (1-theta)^2. Monotone functions are mixtures of steps and squared L2 error is convex. The least-favorable step prior has positive interior density and endpoint atoms; its F obeys F(1-F)=c p*^2. Exact square completion and Cauchy-Schwarz imply the global lower bound within the specified family and force uniqueness. Direct numerical integration checks 79 equalities/inequalities. No finite experiment is used to prove the universal result.

value.rationale: The source 2022 paper identifies a natural concrete worst-case variance problem for bounded monotone integration and reports a uniform one-sample error benchmark 1/12 while highlighting unknown overall optimality. Exact joint importance-density/control design strictly improves that benchmark by 6.09% and proves the unique sharp optimum for a reusable natural estimator class. The explicit least-favorable monotone-step distribution and saddle are useful to design/benchmark one-evaluation unbiased integrators; the result is not a renaming or arbitrary parameter slice.
